from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyInvestingCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """Net cash from investing activities for a company, capturing both current and prior periods for comparison."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Company name")
    current_quarter_label: str | None = Field(description="Line item label as written in the current period")
    current_quarter_amount: float | None = Field(description="Net cash from investing for current quarter (negative if outflow)")
    current_quarter_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of the amount, e.g. 'thousands'")
    current_quarter_period: str | None = Field(description="Current quarter end date, e.g. 'March 31, 2024'")
    prior_quarter_label: str | None = Field(description="Line item label as written in the prior period")
    prior_quarter_amount: float | None = Field(description="Net cash from investing for prior quarter (negative if outflow)")
    prior_quarter_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of the amount, e.g. 'thousands'")
    prior_quarter_period: str | None = Field(description="Prior quarter end date, e.g. 'March 31, 2023'")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the cash flow figures")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_investing_cash_flows: list[CompanyInvestingCashFlow]
